input_contract.R1: blinded retained low-field NMR peak summaries and/or scrubbed JCAMP-DX spectra for the exact ten-member cohort

analysis_family.description: For each sample, score absolute robust deviation of NMR peak count within the same reagent stratum and globally.
Represent each spectrum by its picked peak positions; use a predeclared 0.10 ppm matching tolerance and score distance to the nearest other sample with the same reagent.
Same 0.10 ppm peak-set distance but nearest neighbour across the full cohort, to avoid assuming reagent stratification is correct.
Bin picked peaks into fixed 0.25 ppm bins over the observed shared proton-NMR range and score leave-one-out distance to same-reagent and global occupancy centroids.
Combine only ranks (not calibrated scores) from A1-A4 and report Pareto/top-k candidates; do not tune weights after reveal.

distance_contract.peakset_distance: 1 - symmetric tolerant match F1: greedily count a peak as matched when an unused counterpart is within 0.10 ppm; precision=matches/|A|, recall=matches/|B|, F1=2PR/(P+R), distance=1-F1.
distance_contract.robust_deviation: absolute deviation from stratum median divided by max(MAD,1 peak); report raw counts too.
distance_contract.occupancy: binary peak presence per fixed 0.25 ppm bin; use Hamming distance normalized by number of bins.

success_receipt.primary: Known published anomaly's opaque case is top-3 in at least two independent A1-A4 routes while false-alarm burden remains bounded; exact source label is owner-side only.
success_receipt.strong: Anomaly is top-3 in an analysis route that was not structurally guaranteed by its source ID/metadata and a claim-challenge rationale can be stated without exact post-hoc identity.
success_receipt.negative_is_valid: Failure to rank the published anomaly is preserved as evidence that simple retained-summary anomaly search is insufficient; no tuning after reveal.

guards: No target-specific templates or hand-selected ppm regions.
No weights tuned after R1 reveal.
Peak-summary success does not imply exact structure identification.
Model-free outlier score is only a pursuit trigger; Reality/orthogonal characterization remains validator.
